workspace_to_cloudmap.join: registry company_links (role=primary, status=active) company_uuid -> cloudmap.companyuuid; workspace_uuid -> cloudmap.workspaceuuid
workspace_to_cloudmap.cardinality: 1 workspace : 1 primary company in v0.1 (cloudmap unique companyuuid and unique workspaceuuid)

erp_application_state_notes.maintenance: cloudmap has no maintenance value; shown as degraded (lossy, documented)
erp_application_state_notes.retiring: cloudmap has no retiring value; instance still serves until retired (lossy, documented)

integration_health_aggregation: worst of active connections in order failed > blocked > degraded > suspended > unknown > healthy > closed; not enforced in v0.1 fixtures

rules: existing shared companies keep legacy_compatibility until an explicit per-company cutover (L1, L4)
applying a snapshot never changes the mode (L2)
rollback is a new projection revision with legacy_compatibility (L5)

snapshot.content: effective mgmt.* codes of the workspace resolved from enabled assignments, bundle inheritance and dependency closure

state_separation.rule: has_entitlement answers the commercial right; is_operational answers runtime readiness (ENT-001 §26)

acl_separation: Entitlements never grant Moodle capabilities or BMS RBAC; check order entitlement -> company scope -> capability -> business rule (entitlement_service 0.6.7)
